accountDeletion.title: Verify account deletion
accountDeletion.lead: Please review the consequences before continuing.
accountDeletion.warning: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.
accountDeletion.confirmLead: Confirming will result in the following:
accountDeletion.bullet1: Your account and profile will be permanently erased from our servers.
accountDeletion.bullet2: All active domains associated with your account will be deleted and released for public registration.
accountDeletion.bullet3: Any associated tokens and sessions will be instantly invalidated.
accountDeletion.bullet4: Your username will immediately become available for others to register.
accountDeletion.invalidDesc: This deletion link is invalid or has expired. Please log in and request a new deletion link if you still wish to delete your account.
accountDeletion.noCodeDesc: No valid account deletion token was found. If you requested to delete your account, please check the link sent to your email or request a new deletion confirmation from your account settings.
